purpose: Strain-tensor fault detection in diamond-cubic Si, with scope limited to athermal close-pair recovery.
supersedes: v1.0 — see audit_v1 below. Three FATAL defects; the magnetic mechanisms had no referent.

substrate.NOTE: no magnetic coupling term exists on this sublattice. Si-28 (92% abundant) has nuclear spin I=0: no exchange, no ordering, no magnetic bonds between lattice sites. The ABSENCE of magnetic coupling is precisely why Si is a good spin-qubit host (spin-orbit split-off ~44 meV).

principles.invariants: I1=Tr(e) volumetric; J2 deviatoric; J3 mode
principles.invariant_blindness: I1, J2, J3 are rotation-invariant. ORIENTATION faults require eigenvector comparison, not spectrum. Demonstrated in silicon_check.py: a rotated tensor has identical invariants to machine precision and a nonzero frame misalignment.
principles.coupling: elastic via stiffness tensor + electronic via orbital overlap. NOT magnetic.

thresholds.units: multiples of thermal sigma at operating T
thresholds.sigma_theta_derivation: Debye-Waller <u^2> ~ 0.006 A^2 at 300K -> u_rms 0.0775 A over d = 2.352 A -> atan(u/d) = 1.89 deg
thresholds.RATIONALE: elastic working range 1e-4..1e-3; bulk fracture ~1e-2. v1 thresholds sat above fracture and at the noise floor respectively.
thresholds.NOTE_ON_sqrtJ2: the trip is on sqrt(J2), which carries strain units, not on J2, which carries strain^2. v1 left this ambiguous.

readout.CONSEQUENCE: detection latency exceeds correction time by ~6.7e8. This sensor DETECTS AFTER THE FACT. It cannot gate a ps-scale event.
readout.EIGENVECTOR_CHANNEL: RESOLVED — polarization-resolved Raman reads eigenvectors via Oh selection rules (optical_interface.md). Which directions to sample is settled by tensor_readout.py: the four sp3 directions are rank-deficient and blind to the E doublet; the six <110> directions are complete. See ttm_audit.md, TTM-2/TTM-3.

athermal_recovery.process: close Frenkel pair recombination within capture radius
athermal_recovery.cycle_time_check: Si optical phonon 15.6 THz -> 64 fs period; 1.5 ps = 23 periods. Consistent with a lattice-mediated athermal event.

thermal_recovery.scope: OUT OF SCOPE for ps budget — 6 orders too slow

REMOVED_v1: magnetic coupling loss — no mechanism; Si is diamagnetic
strain redistribution — unspecified, no rate law
reorientation to nearest valid tensor configuration — group unspecified, not implementable

correction_energy_aJ.NOTE: v1's flat 1.2 aJ = 7.49 eV was defect-type agnostic. Landauer kT*ln2 at 300K = 0.0029 aJ for scale; v1's figure was 418x the bound.

falsifiers: SIL-1 orientation fault detected by any invariant alone -> the blindness claim is wrong
SIL-2 athermal recovery observed beyond r_c = 1.5 nm -> capture radius wrong
SIL-3 recovery at 300K faster than 3.6 us for a SEPARATED pair -> a non-Arrhenius channel exists
SIL-4 any measured magnetic coupling on the Si sublattice -> substrate block wrong

FATAL: magnetic coupling loss / magneto-thermal relaxation: Si is diamagnetic, chi ~ -3.4e-6, Si-28 has I=0. There is nothing to lose 10% of.
bond angle > 2 deg: 2 deg IS the thermal noise floor at 300K (sigma ~1.9 deg). The threshold sat at ~1 sigma, giving a false-positive rate near 32% per sample.
trace deviation > 0.02: if T is strain, Tr = dilatation = dV/V, so 0.02 = 2% volume change. Bulk Si fractures near 1%. The flag raised AFTER the crystal had already failed — off by ~2 orders.
cycle_time_ps 1.5 conflated elastic/phonon relaxation (~ps) with thermal defect migration (~us). One number cannot be both.
HIGH: trace as sole invariant: trace sees only volume. All DEVIATORIC (shape) faults are invisible, and shear is exactly the failure mode of interest.
self_healing block asserted, not derived. Si does not spontaneously anneal at operating temperature; separated defects need >150 C. One real athermal mechanism exists and is now the whole scope.
'nearest valid tensor configuration': which group? Si site symmetry is Td (24 elements, 12 proper rotations); the lattice is Oh. Unspecified means not implementable.
MED: correction_energy_aJ 1.2 stated as a fixed scalar with no defect-type dependence.

metadata.linked_NOTE: RESOLVED — the Td/Oh mismatch was real. Octahedral_State_Encoder v1.0 derived 8 states from a 6-fold octahedral site and padded its map with two non-directional fillers to reach 8. v2.0 indexes the 8 <111> bond directions instead (4 sp3 bonds x 2 sublattices, related by the inversion centre), which is Td site symmetry plus the inversion that makes the crystal Oh. The 8-state / 3-bit result is unaffected; the derivation is. The encoder's NAME remains misleading and renaming it is still open.
